sources: https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/determine_quota_cost (Quota Calculator, updated 2026-11-12): 'default quota allocation of 100 search.list calls, 100 videos.insert calls, and 10,000 units per day combined for all other endpoints'; search.list '100 quota per day. Each call costs 1 quota'; videos.list, channels.list and playlistItems.list cost 1.
https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/reference/rest/v3/search/list (updated 2026-11-12): 'A call to this method has a quota cost of 1 unit in the Search Queries quota bucket.'
https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/revision_history (2026-06-01): search.list and videos.insert moved to their own quota buckets.
note: Edit this table, not the code, if Google changes a cost or your project's Quotas page in the Google Cloud console shows other limits. Before 2026-06-01 search.list cost 100 units of the shared pool; on a project still billed that way set search.list to {"bucket": "default", "cost": 100}. Every request is charged, including failed and retried ones.
